toolsPreview.name: search_keywords
toolsPreview.description: Look up Amazon search volume, depth, trend, and 12-month history for a keyword.

toolsPreview.name: search_asin
toolsPreview.description: Reverse ASIN lookup — get product details and the top keywords it ranks for.

toolsPreview.name: get_serp
toolsPreview.description: Get all products on page 1 of Amazon search results for a keyword, with prices, stars, and reviews.

toolsPreview.name: related_keywords
toolsPreview.description: Find keywords related to a seed keyword via ASIN co-occurrence (Keyword Multiplier).

toolsPreview.name: bulk_keywords
toolsPreview.description: Look up volume and depth for up to 1000 keywords in one call.

toolsPreview.name: get_markets
toolsPreview.description: List all supported Amazon marketplaces and their data coverage.

toolsPreview.name: get_account
toolsPreview.description: Show the caller's MerchantWords API plan, live rate-limit and bulk-quota usage, and the full list of plans with their prices, rate limits, and quotas. Call this to check remaining quota before a large job, or to tell the user which upgrade unlocks more throughput/volume.
